title: ti&m's Flowable listing is a recycled Mimacom record, so the partnership is unverified
content:
The ti&m AG entry comes with a warning about its own source: Flowable's CMS record for the firm is recycled from a different company, Mimacom, so the listing does not establish that ti&m is currently a Flowable partner. The firm itself is recorded at 550-plus engineers across Zurich, Bern, Basel, Frankfurt and Duesseldorf.

This is the most serious data-quality flag in the sweep, because it undermines the qualifying attribute rather than a detail beside it. Elsewhere the gaps are missing websites, unpublished cities or unverified headcounts — annoying but peripheral. Here the platform relationship, which is the entire reason the row exists, may belong to another company, and a pitch built on an assumed Flowable practice would land wrong in the first meeting.

It also tells you something about the directory as a source. A partner finder that reuses CMS records across companies can carry stale or transplanted entries anywhere in the list, so the sweep's other rows deserve the same scepticism about their partnership status, not just about their contact details. Verify ti&m's partnership directly before any outreach. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder (flowable.com/company/partners), mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
